title: phyllanthus distichus f. nodiflorus
intro: Phyllanthus distichus f. nodiflorus, commonly known as the 'Floating Plantain', is a plant species of the Euphorbiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, as well as being used as an antidote for poisoning. The plant has been shown to possess therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus distichus f. nodiflorus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic properties.
